items.why: Chips are getting hammered across the board, with Lam Research off 10% and Intel down over 5% as the AI trade takes pressure from high spending fears.
Sinking with the Nasdaq as AI spending concerns hit big AI names and chip weakness spreads across the tape.
Chip stocks declining broadly as the AI trade comes under pressure, with reports of a $3 trillion rout in the sector.
Sliding with the broader sell-off as rising oil prices and tech jitters weigh on the market.

market_note: Futures stayed red into midday, with Nasdaq futures off over 2% and crude climbing on Mideast tensions.
summary: Stocks are sliding Thursday as chip names get hammered on AI spending concerns and oil climbs on Mideast tensions. The Nasdaq is down over 2% and the VIX is up more than 10%.
